entries.title: Announcing Gemma 3n preview: Powerful, efficient, mobile-first AI
entries.titleJa: Gemma 3n プレビュー発表:モバイル特化の高効率AIモデル
entries.titleEn: Announcing Gemma 3n preview: Powerful, efficient, mobile-first AI
entries.summaryJa: GoogleはオンデバイスAI向けの新モデル「Gemma 3n」のプレビューを発表した。Per-Layer Embeddings等の革新で2〜3GBのRAMで動作し、テキスト・画像・音声・動画のマルチモーダル入力に対応。Qualcomm、MediaTek、Samsungと協業しスマホやノートPCでの高速推論を実現する。
entries.summaryEn: Google has previewed Gemma 3n, a mobile-first generative AI model engineered to run efficiently on phones, tablets and laptops with as little as 2GB of RAM. Built on innovations like Per-Layer Embeddings and co-developed with Qualcomm, MediaTek and Samsung, it supports multimodal text, image, audio and video input.

image.alt: Announcing Gemma 3n preview: Powerful, efficient, mobile-first AI
